API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPolicy ResourcesIP Source Group Z Resource Get Source IP Group By ID
IP Source Group Z Resource Get Source IP Group By ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ipSourceGroups/:ipGroupId

Retrieves the source IP group based on the specified source IP group ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ipGroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The ID of the source IP group.

Responses
​
default

default response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

ID of the IP address group or IP pool.

name
string

Name of the IP address group or IP pool.

ipAddresses
string[]

IP addresses included in the IP group or IP pool.

description
string

Description of the IP group or IP pool.

creatorContext
string

Indicates whether the IP group or IP pool is created in Cloud & Branch Connector (EC) or ZIA.

Possible values: [ZIA, EC]

isNonEditable
boolean

Indicates if the IP group is view-only (true) or is editable (false).
